No claim about tree-GP or Cartesian GP from GP; no claim about neural architecture search from NAS.

No claim on 'Predict evolvability on genuinely future task families.' or 'Validate developmental predictions on continual-learning systems.' - both deliberately left OPEN.
No claim on any row owned by #910 / PR #924.
No claim on 'Derive operator invention.' or 'Derive library formation.'
